blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) will refer its findings on the alleged discrepancy in Vice President Sara Duterte’s Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth or SALN to the Office of the Ombudsman, according to Director Melvin Matibag. In an interview, Matibag said NBI agents will file their findings with the Ombudsman on Tuesday afternoon. “Ang team ng NBI will file our findings doon sa aming ginawa na pag-imbestiga na yan at sila na yung pagpatuloy pa ng investigation dito.
